info.title: Kiwi.com API
info.description:
Search and compare flights on Kiwi.com — itineraries with live prices, airlines, routes and departure/arrival times, plus location and route discovery.

Every request needs an API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys. A successful request uses one credit, unless its operation says more (`x-credits`). That price covers 200 rows (or the operation's `x-credits-rows`); a request that returns more pays it again for each further page of that many rows. The `x-maviapi-credits` response header says what a request cost. A query param an operation does not take is ignored and named in the `x-maviapi-unknown-params` response header; send the `x-maviapi-strict: 1` request header to have such a request refused with a free `400 unknown_param` instead.

Endpoint reference with live examples: https://maviapi.com/apis/kiwi

get.description:
Airports within a radius of a point, nearest first, with distance, city, country, time zone and Kiwi popularity.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: latitude of the point, decimal degrees.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: longitude of the point, decimal degrees.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: search radius in km (default 150, max 500).

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: "true" also returns airports Kiwi sells no flights from (small airfields, military fields).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows in one page, 1 to 50 (default 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the page starts (default 0).

get.description:
The cheapest flight to every destination city from a place, like kiwi.com's 'anywhere' search: one row per city with price, origin and destination airports, local and UTC times and, for round trips, nights and return date. expand attaches the top 3 full itineraries for the first N cities.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: origin. A 3-letter upper-case code is an airport (else a metro city code such as LON), an upper-case 2-letter code a country (else a continent such as EU); otherwise a name of any place type, case and accent insensitive, or a search id from /places-v2 (Airport:CRL, Country:TR). Unclear or unknown values answer 400 with candidates.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: optional broad scope for the destinations: a country, subdivision, region or continent (code, name or search id); 'anywhere' for every destination.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: start of the departure window, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to 30 days from today.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: end of the departure window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; defaults to date_from.

parameters.name: return_from
parameters.description: start of the return window, YYYY-MM-DD; set it for a round trip, omit for one-way.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: end of the return window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; defaults to return_from.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: lowest price per destination, in currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: highest price per destination, in currency.

parameters.name: max_stops
parameters.description: most stops per leg (0 = direct only); omit for any.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: adult passengers (1-9).

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: child passengers (0-8).

parameters.name: infants
parameters.description: infant passengers, at most one per adult.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: which flight represents each city and the order of the cities: PRICE (cheapest first), POPULARITY (kiwi.com's popular destinations first), QUALITY, DURATION or DATE. The set of cities differs a little per sort.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: price currency, 3-letter ISO code; min_price and max_price use it too.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: attach the top 3 itineraries (segments, airlines, booking link) to the destinations ranked 1 to N; 0 = none.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows in one page, 1 to 1000 (default 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the page starts (default 0).

get.description:
Flight itineraries for departure (and optional return) date windows, with prices, segments, airlines, local and UTC times and booking links. The list holds at most cap (50) itineraries, in the order of sort; capped is true when kiwi.com had more for the search than were returned, so narrow the search (dates, places, price, stops) to see the rest.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: origin. A 3-letter upper-case code is an airport, searched together with the other airports of its metro area as kiwi.com does (IST also finds SAW), else a metro city code such as LON; an upper-case 2-letter code a country (else a continent such as EU); otherwise a name of any place type (city, airport, subdivision, country, region, continent), case and accent insensitive, or a search id from /places-v2 (Airport:CRL, Country:TR). Unclear or unknown values answer 400 with candidates.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: destination, same rules as from, plus 'anywhere'.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: start of the departure window, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to 30 days from today.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: end of the departure window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; defaults to date_from.

parameters.name: return_from
parameters.description: start of the return window, YYYY-MM-DD; set it for a round trip, omit for one-way.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: end of the return window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; defaults to return_from.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: lowest total price, in currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: highest total price, in currency.

parameters.name: max_stops
parameters.description: most stops per leg (0 = direct only); omit for any.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: adult passengers (1-9).

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: child passengers (0-8).

parameters.name: infants
parameters.description: infant passengers, at most one per adult.

parameters.name: cabin
parameters.description: cabin class.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: order of the list: QUALITY (kiwi.com's best first, then the rest of what it has), PRICE (cheapest first) or DURATION (shortest first).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: price currency, 3-letter ISO code; min_price and max_price use it too.

get.description:
Every itinerary kiwi.com has for up to 3 origins and 3 destinations over departure (and return) date windows, with local departure and arrival time windows. Each itinerary names the origin and destination it matched (origin, destination), its fetch time and when its quoted price expires; total_estimate counts them and total_exact says whether none of the underlying searches was cut off.

Each successful request uses 5 credits.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: origin: one place or a comma list of up to 3 (BRU,CRL or LON,STN). Each item: a 3-letter upper-case code is an airport (else a metro city code such as LON), an upper-case 2-letter code a country (else a continent); otherwise a name of any place type, case and accent insensitive, or a search id from /places-v2 (Airport:CRL). Names containing a comma need their search id. Unclear items answer 400 with candidates.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: destination: one place or a comma list of up to 3, same rules, or 'anywhere' alone.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: start of the departure window, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to 30 days from today.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: end of the departure window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, at most 92 days after date_from; defaults to date_from.

parameters.name: return_from
parameters.description: start of the return window, YYYY-MM-DD; set it for a round trip, omit for one-way.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: end of the return window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; defaults to return_from.

parameters.name: departure_from
parameters.description: earliest local departure time of the outbound leg, HH:MM, at the first departure airport.

parameters.name: departure_to
parameters.description: latest local departure time of the outbound leg, HH:MM inclusive (up to 24:00). A window cannot cross midnight.

parameters.name: arrival_from
parameters.description: earliest local arrival time of the outbound leg, HH:MM, at the final arrival airport.

parameters.name: arrival_to
parameters.description: latest local arrival time of the outbound leg, HH:MM inclusive (up to 24:00). A window cannot cross midnight.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: lowest total price, in currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: highest total price, in currency.

parameters.name: max_stops
parameters.description: most stops per leg (0 = direct only); omit for any.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: adult passengers (1-9).

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: child passengers (0-8).

parameters.name: infants
parameters.description: infant passengers, at most one per adult.

parameters.name: cabin
parameters.description: cabin class.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: PRICE or DURATION sort all itineraries; QUALITY keeps kiwi.com's ranking inside each part of the search (the best of each first), then price.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: price currency, 3-letter ISO code; min_price and max_price use it too.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows in one page, 1 to 200 (default 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the page starts (default 0).

maviapiKey.description: Your maviapi API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys.

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Row fields to keep in a list answer, comma separated (at most 50). A dot reaches into an object, or into each object of an array (venue.city). A name no row has is a 400 that lists the fields a row has.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: pagination.next_cursor of the previous page, sent with the same other params: the next page of the same stored copy of the list, so a walk never skips or repeats a row when the cache refreshes or the site reorders. A cursor for other params is 400 invalid_cursor; a copy that is gone is 410 cursor_expired (start again without cursor).

MaxAge.name: max_age
MaxAge.description: Serve a stored answer only when it was read at most this many seconds ago (0 to 86400); older, the site is read again. 0 is refresh=true. Any other value is 400 invalid_max_age.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may succeed later without any change. When true, wait the seconds in `Retry-After` (if sent) first.

FetchedAt.description: When this data was read from the site (ISO 8601, UTC). Also in the x-maviapi-fetched-at header.

Age.description: Seconds since fetched_at: 0 for a fresh read, more for a stored answer. Also in the Age header.

NextCursor.description: Send as `cursor`, with the same other params, for the next page of the same copy of the list; null on the last page.

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or cannot be used (`bad_request`), or, with the `x-maviapi-strict: 1` request header, a query param the operation does not take was sent (`unknown_param`, with the names in `params`).

Unauthorized.description: No API key was sent, or the key is invalid or revoked (`missing_api_key`, `invalid_api_key`).

example.message: Provide an API key via the Authorization: Bearer <key> header.

CreditLimitReached.description: The plan's credits for this period are used up.

example.message: You've used all 1,000 credits in your Free plan for this period. Upgrade your plan for a higher allotment.

AccountSuspended.description: The account that owns the key is suspended.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this key (`rate_limited`), or too many at once for its plan (`concurrency_limited`). Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

example.message: Rate limit exceeded for this API key (600 requests a minute).

UpstreamFailed.description: The source site could not be read this time. Retrying later usually works.

example.message: The upstream source could not be fetched

CursorExpired.description: The stored copy of the list this cursor walks is gone. Start the list again without cursor.

example.message: The copy of the list this cursor walks is gone. Start the list again without cursor.
